title: Postdoctoral Research Associates
institution: James Madison Program in American Ideals and Institutions, Princeton University

compensation.evidence_quote: fully funded, 12-month postdoctoral research associate appointment with benefits

about: Princeton's James Madison Program invites applications for a fully funded 12-month postdoctoral research associate appointment through the Department of Politics, 1 September 2027 to 1 September 2028. Priority deadline: 4 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. EST.
requirements: Recent Ph.D. recipients, or candidates expecting the Ph.D. before the appointment start date
Less than two years of post-Ph.D. research experience prior to the anticipated start date
Must be in residence in Princeton or the local vicinity and may not be employed by another institution during the appointment
Application: cover letter, CV, a scholarly paper written in the past three years, research statement (max 1,500 words), two references, via Interfolio

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "a scholarly paper written in the past three years, research statement (max 1,500 words)" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

"Recent Ph.D. recipients" building a research profile → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
